teaser: You switch platforms twice before the announcement finishes, rain blowing sideways under the shelter, already turning over three ways to make the delay interesting. Life path 3 and the ENTP mind meet here, in that habit of narrating a wait rather than enduring it. The 3 asks for expression — a voice, a joke, a story told well. ENTP thinking wants a question to chew on, an angle nobody else has tried yet. Crossed, the two make a person who can talk a stalled train into an anecdote worth repeating, and who sometimes forgets to notice whether the train ever actually arrived.
